observation.claim: A governed observation can be rendered in client-readable language without collapsing verified facts into interpretation.
verifiedFacts: The canonical Observation contract stores verifiedFacts and inference in separate arrays.
The canonical Observation contract exposes confidence, limitations, source references, and approval state as separate fields.
Daily intake is constrained to candidate approval state until a separate governed transition occurs.
inference: A client-facing rendering can remain legible while preserving the canonical epistemic boundaries.
Explicit trace pointers reduce the risk that presentation copy silently outruns the underlying record.
observation.significance: The specimen provides a bounded handoff surface for client review while keeping the canonical observation auditable and unchanged.
assumptions: The client view is generated deterministically from the embedded observation rather than authored as an independent claim source.
knownLimitations: This fixture proves the data contract and presentation boundary, not a production user interface.
The fixture source reference is synthetic and must not be represented as external evidence.

clientView.title: A client-readable observation that keeps evidence and interpretation separate
verifiedSummary: Verified facts and interpretation are stored separately.
Confidence, evidence, limitations, and approval state remain visible.
The observation cannot become accepted knowledge through this presentation layer.
interpretationSummary: This structure should make client review easier without weakening traceability.
Trace pointers should make unsupported wording easier to detect.
clientView.whyItMatters: Clients can understand what is known, what is inferred, why it matters, and what decision remains without being asked to read the canonical JSON directly.

confidence.label: high
confidence.basis: The presentation fields map directly to explicit canonical Observation fields.

limitations: No production interface or client usability study is included.
The source is synthetic and cannot support an external factual claim.
clientView.nextDecision: Approve the v0 contract for implementation as a read-only client presentation adapter, or request bounded field changes.
prohibitedClaims: Do not describe this fixture as accepted knowledge.
Do not describe the synthetic source as independent external evidence.
Do not infer implementation or client usability from schema validity alone.
